categories.main_business_segments: Integrity Technology Group Inc. primarily operates in digital security testing and evaluation, network range (cyber range) construction and operation, security protection and control, cybersecurity competition services, and online/offline training services. The company focuses on providing professional 'digital wind tunnel' testing and evaluation products and services to government and enterprise users, supporting digital health and security compliance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary network space parallel simulation, network offense and defense confrontation technology, and multi-cycle digital wind tunnel testing and evaluation technology. It has developed a high-performance proprietary cloud platform (Spring and Autumn Cloud) and employs advanced virtualization, big data analytics, AI-driven threat simulation, and automated multi-cycle testing methods. The company also holds numerous patents and software copyrights supporting these technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government departments, military and defense sectors, central enterprises, energy, power, telecommunications, finance, and private enterprises. The company serves critical infrastructure operators and provides cybersecurity solutions tailored to digital government, AI safety, data security, industrial security, connected vehicles, and cybersecurity insurance sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and has expanded its presence in key regions including North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. It has also established operations in Hong Kong to serve local markets and plans to expand internationally leveraging its Hong Kong subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: Integrity Technology Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cybersecurity supply chain, focusing on software product development, cybersecurity service provision, and digital security infrastructure operation. It procures hardware and software components externally but develops core technologies and products in-house.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in AI security, digital wind tunnel testing, data security, and network range technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI-driven security evaluation, multi-cycle testing, and cloud platform enhancements. Strategic priorities include expanding AI safety testing capabilities, enhancing product-service integration, and fostering cybersecurity talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through sales of proprietary cybersecurity software products, provision of cybersecurity services including testing, evaluation, training, and competition operations. The company employs a project-based sales model with direct sales complemented by channel sales through integrators. It also offers subscription and service contracts for ongoing cybersecurity solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's digital security testing and evaluation and network range sectors, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds a dominant market share in network range products and leads in cybersecurity talent training services. Competitors include domestic and international cybersecurity firms, but Integrity maintains a first-mover advantage with proprietary technologies and extensive industry certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 395.87 million, a 19.72% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 31.11 million, down 38.78% due to increased R&D and marketing investments. The company’s R&D expenditure accounted for 21.24% of revenue, reflecting a growth focus. Total assets reached RMB 1.40 billion with steady growth in equity and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Integrity Technology Group differentiates itself through its proprietary parallel simulation technology, multi-cycle digital wind tunnel testing, and integrated product-service solutions. It positions itself as a 'digital health' guardian, offering comprehensive, automated, and repeatable security testing that quantifies security effectiveness and supports continuous risk mitigation. Its products are recognized for high fidelity, scalability, and integration with AI safety, making it a trusted 'family doctor' for digital security in critical sectors.
